construction.base: R44BR shared-pivot family from k R44AS blocks
construction.connector_seed: C_i^(0)=(x1_i OR not x3_(i+1) OR x4_i)
construction.connector_orbit: Add C_i^(t)=pi^t(C_i^(0)) for t=0..11, where pi is the R44BP signed permutation applied identically to every block.

sat_and_connectivity.orbit_truth_argument: pi^t(x1) has truth pattern F,T,F,T,F,T on its six-cycle; not x3 = pi(x1), so the first two literals of every connector are consecutive phases and at least one is true.

rank_theorem.parent_after_connectors: 15k-13 and maxdef-critical by repeated critical-extension lemma

congruence_rigidity.effect: The connector orbit changes no binary implication edges. Exhaustive polynomial binary-SCC/equality quotienting therefore has only singleton variable classes.
congruence_rigidity.seal: CONNECTEDNESS + UNBOUNDED SUPPORT SURVIVES R44BW BINARY CONGRUENCE QUOTIENT

transport.forward_exists: Apply the R44BP pi independently in every block; the connector set is a complete pi-orbit and is therefore mapped into itself.
transport.lower_bound_reason: If a target block is identity on all five variables, purely local target clauses can only be witnessed by same-block local source clauses; orbit connectors span two blocks and cannot be subsets of local images. This would force the forbidden identity base transport/substitution.

theorem_effect.does_not_refute: Polynomial structured discovery of the full orbit action, or stronger affine/circuit/model-map relations.

scope_firewalls: EXPLICIT_PI_ORBIT_FAMILY MAY STILL HAVE POLYNOMIAL STRUCTURED DISCOVERY
next_exact_question: Can the orbit symmetry itself be recovered polynomially from connected congruence-rigid siblings, or can one construct a critical family where every safe transport relation in this fixed syntactic class lacks a polynomially recognizable global generator?
